cohort: The study utilized data from genome-wide association studies (GWASs) including up to 458,109 participants.
finding: The study provides new evidence demonstrating causal effects of various genetically predicted risk factors and nutrients on inflammatory bowel diseases, including ulcerative colitis, non-infective colitis, and Crohn's disease.
mod_finding: Genetically driven cesarean delivery was found to increase the risk of Crohn's disease.
